book.name: 2 THESALONIKA
book.title: THESALONIKA KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIHNINGNAH

content: Thlawchang a naw he
A changnah letaco uny sahlo, naaning khatah a cangpaw hrakhei Khazing bia cawh a kaipaza tlamang khy nápawtah le pasungpanaw a cang khy nápawtah kaa cawtah thlaw ma changpah my lo.
Taico mehchawly le mehrahry sahlo hrong taitah a bingsah kaa cang khy nápaw caw zong tah thlawchang my lo, zecawtamaw tatah ming maikaw tah zingnah hnui bei he.
Canghrasala Abuipaw cawh zingchuipaw cang ka, Ama taco naa thaw tlung sá ka, mehchaw lypaw Setan taitah a ca bingsá he.
Kaa ca chingpaw he khah tua he ceh ka, naa tua pazo longmang a taheh Abuipaw letah zingnah kaa hnui.
Abuipaw tah naa lungthing cawh Khazing donah le Khri mua ing khynah lang khah langhme chui ky seh.
Thawthih ly rua pawtah raering pehnah
Uny sahlo, a thawthipaw zingtu le kaaning taitei naa cyhlangpaw cawngpahnah hratei a ung lypaw he khah a huikong khe lo, tatah Abuipaw Zisu Khri ming tah bia kaa ca peh he.
Zehratamaw naa ma mingpai he ceh tahpaw khah naaning ceingei tah naa hnipaw a cang. Naaning khatei kaa ungning takhei kaa thaw thi be kho.
Amai peh lytah aho batui hmai e bei peh. A cang ly hlui tah aho naa caw tahmai phorih cang ly rua pawtah reithui sisaw ing tah, ching kha, zai kha rai kaa hre kho.
Ma hratei kaa tuapaw khah naaning taitah bongnah hmuhnah naw kaa hnuilynah cawtah cang lytah a ma mingpai he seh la, kaa haa a ma lah he seh, kaa tah cawtah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah naaning khatei kaa ungning takhei, “Rai a hre lypaw cawngsaw cawh e kheh seh,” tahpaw phung khah, kaa ca peh he kho.
Naa hrong letah mehthaikheh cawh aa thaw a thi tahpaw kaa thui. Aaning sahlo cawh raihre lytah male a pahnong a pakha laipaw a cang he.
Ma hapaw cawngsaw sahlo cawh a ningcang teitah ung pawtah le, aaning pori congnah rai hre pawtah, Abuipaw Zisu Khri ming tah bia pei he peh ka, kaa sia he.
Taico uny sahlo, naaning cawh a dingpaw hming tua tah ca ning kheh he seh.
Ma ca letei kaa ca chingpaw he a nge du lypaw cawngsaw cawh achaw teitah a ngia thlang my lo. A ningzeh seh tatah ma cawngsaw cawh a kong khe lo.
A cang naná tah caraepaw hraco rawh khe la, unypaw hratah raeringnah pei hri my lo.
Ahning cai kih tlenah
Denah Buipaw, Ama hrahring tah denah cawh ching lytah zezong hmingting letah ca pei ky he seh. Abuipaw cawh naa zongmingtei khatah ung ky seh.
Kama Paul tah ma a changnah kih tlenah ca heh kama ka kih ceingei tah ka ciapaw a cang tahpaw cawh ka cakua vytei letah a bi thlang. Ma hrahei ka cia ningcang a cang.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri ningdonah cawh naa zongmingtei khatah ung ky seh.
